one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent never read the task specification to learn the required output path and format, so it persistently saved solutions to 'solution.npy' instead of '/app/solution.txt' and optimized the wrong objective (missing the L2 regularization term) across all 16 steps.
t_err_evidence: Step 2 writes solve_optimization.py with 'np.save("solution.npy", result.x)' instead of the required '/app/solution.txt', and the objective omits the L2 regularization term; these two errors are never corrected.
t_commit_evidence: By step 8, the agent has tried multiple methods and seen the L-BFGS-B constraint warning (step 7), then rewrites to SLSQP which will run successfully but still saves to solution.npy with a wrong objective; from this point no external signal arrives and the agent iterates only on optimization method, never on output format or objective correctness.
trigger_explanation: The agent jumped directly to implementing a solver without reading any task specification file to determine the required output path ('/app/solution.txt'), output format (text via np.savetxt), or the exact objective function (which includes an L2 regularization term visible in the evaluator's gradient check). It acted on assumptions about the output format throughout the entire trajectory.
forewarning_evidence: Step 7 output shows 'RuntimeWarning: Method L-BFGS-B cannot handle constraints' and Constraint violation: 373.19, signaling the solver is not working correctly; the agent responds by changing method but still ignores the output format issue.
